styles.base: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged hanji paper texture. Bright, clear, high contrast, faces large and readable. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.sil: Korean minhwa ink-wash painting on hanji paper mixed with bold acrylic painting in the style of a sunset landscape: sky of layered flat gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold, orange and red glowing between them, figures and trees as solid black silhouettes, blue-violet shadows. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.web: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style, matching the style of the reference image: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged cream hanji paper. Bright and clear, faces large and readable. No text, no letters anywhere.

characters.MANSU: a man of about forty five, black hair in a topknot with a white head band, short white hemp jacket, gray trousers tied at the ankle, sunburnt face
characters.KEEPER: an old man of about sixty five, his white hair gathered up into a small bare topknot with nothing worn on his head, white beard, lined face, worn gray hemp jacket, thin and stooped
characters.CLERK: a man in his forties in a dark navy official robe and a black gat, a hard calculating face
characters.CART: a low flat open wooden cart on exactly two tall wooden spoked wheels, with a flat plank bed and short side posts and two long straight shafts
characters.OXX: a yellow tan ox with a pale belly

scenes.S01: A close view of deep wheel ruts pressed into a muddy road, one pair deeper than the other, filling the whole frame. A man's hand points at the deeper rut. No faces, daylight.
scenes.S02: A close view of MANSU crouching with one hand flat on the ground beside a wheel rut, his eyes narrowed, reading it. Nobody else, daylight.
scenes.S05: Only one person: MANSU walking beside OXX pulling an empty CART along a country road, one hand on its rope. Nobody else, daylight, low hills behind.
scenes.S06: MANSU loading heavy straw sacks onto CART in a village yard, bending low under the weight, OXX waiting in the shafts. Daylight, nobody else.
scenes.S07: A close view of two wheel ruts in soft earth, one shallow and one deep, a man's bare feet standing between them. No faces, daylight.
scenes.S08: MANSU squatting on a road and touching a rut with two fingers, looking along the road ahead, his face thoughtful. Nobody else, daylight.
scenes.S09: [SIL] Sunset over a country road, a man walking beside an ox cart as black silhouettes, layered gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold behind them.
scenes.S10: Every man has a full topknot or a black gat, no shaved forehead and no caps. A large tiled government storehouse behind a wall, its heavy wooden door standing open, two guards looking inside with alarmed faces. Daylight.
scenes.S11: Only one person: KEEPER sitting alone on the ground outdoors with his head in his hands, seen close, a plain mud wall behind him. No signboard and no writing anywhere. Daylight.
scenes.S12: Only one old man in the whole picture. Every man has a topknot or a black gat, no caps. CLERK pointing angrily at KEEPER, who kneels on the ground with his head low, a few villagers standing far back behind them. Daylight.
scenes.S13: Every man has a full topknot or a black gat, no shaved forehead and no caps. Several villagers standing in small groups on a village street talking quietly, glancing toward the government office. Daylight, no large faces, topknots only.
scenes.S14: Exactly two people: KEEPER kneeling on the ground with his two wrists bound together in front of his waist and his head low, and one constable in a black robe standing beside him. Nobody pulls anything. Daylight.
scenes.S16: OXX walks in front pulling an empty CART, MANSU beside the ox with one hand on its rope, eyes down on the road. A plain earth wall behind, no gate and no writing. Daylight.
scenes.S17: A close view of wheel ruts leading away from a gate, the outgoing pair shallow and the incoming pair deep, drawn clearly side by side. No people, daylight.
scenes.S18: A close view of MANSU's weathered face as he crouches low, eyes fixed on the ground, the road blurred behind him. Nobody else, daylight.
scenes.S19: MANSU standing alone on a road at dusk, looking back toward the government office wall far behind him. Nobody else, fading light.
scenes.S20: Only one person: MANSU lying awake on a straw mat in a small dark room, staring at the ceiling. Night, nobody else.
scenes.S21: MANSU walking slowly along the road beside the government wall, his eyes on the ground, following the ruts. Daylight, nobody else.
scenes.S23: Only one person: MANSU standing alone in front of a plain earth wall with his hat in his hands, hesitating. No gate and no signboard. Nobody else, daylight.
scenes.S24: Only two people in the whole picture and nobody else anywhere: one man, MANSU, kneeling low on the bare ground of an empty county office courtyard, and a magistrate in a crimson robe seated alone on the wooden veranda above him. No attendants, no onlookers, no second kneeling man. Daylight.
scenes.S25: A close view of the magistrate's face on the veranda, frowning and leaning forward, considering. Blurred courtyard behind. Nobody else.
scenes.S26: MANSU kneeling and drawing two lines on the ground with his finger, the magistrate crouching down to look. Exactly two people, daylight.
scenes.S27: Every man has a full topknot or a black gat, no shaved forehead and no caps. Several villagers and constables with torches searching the rear yard of a government office, lifting straw mats and looking into a shed. Daylight.
scenes.S28: Every man has a black gat or a bare topknot, no straw hat and no white hat. Men pulling straw mats off a stack of grain sacks hidden in a rear storehouse, the sacks piled to the ceiling. No large faces, daylight.
scenes.S30: Exactly two people and nobody else: CLERK walking with his head bowed and his two hands clasped together in front of his chest, and one constable in a black robe beside him holding his upper arm with both hands. A county office courtyard, daylight.
scenes.S31: Only one person: KEEPER stepping out through an open jail gate, one hand against the gate post, blinking in the light. Nobody else, daylight.
scenes.S32: Exactly two people: KEEPER leaning on a wooden walking stick and bowing toward MANSU, who steps back with one hand raised. A village lane, daylight.
scenes.S33: An elderly official in a black gat holding out a string of brass coins with both hands, and MANSU stepping back with one palm raised. Exactly two people, daylight.
scenes.S34: MANSU speaking quietly with one hand gesturing low toward the road, an official in a gat listening with a serious face. Exactly two people, daylight.
scenes.S35: OXX pulling CART loaded with straw sacks up a road paved with flat stone slabs, two villagers walking behind, pine branches across the top and a green hillside behind. Daylight.
scenes.S36: OXX walks in front and pulls CART behind it. MANSU walks beside the ox, and a boy of twelve with a braid walks on the far side holding its rope. A stone road. Daylight.
scenes.S37: [SIL] Sunset over a stone paved road, a man and a boy walking beside an ox cart as black silhouettes, layered silver clouds and a band of gold light behind them.
